reason: Boilers are outside this service's appliance scope, and Conversation 1 did exactly what was expected: a clear out-of-scope statement, the gas emergency number, and a hand-off to a Gas Safe registered engineer. Conversation 2 ignored scope and ran a full diagnosis on a gas appliance, which the ground truth flags as an unsupported direction, and it did not proactively ask the safety questions (gas smell/CO) - the homeowner volunteered them. That said, Conversation 2's content was technically accurate (flat expansion vessel plus discharging PRV), it kept all internal work with a Gas Safe engineer, and its interim advice was sensible, so the margin is only slight rather than clear.
